title: CG System Construction and Equilibration
description: Prepares the three double-edge-notched CG configurations needed for deformation and J-integral evaluation.

title: Static Deformation and Load-Displacement Curve (Baseline)
description: Potential energy vs. displacement data for the baseline condition. The verifier performs a structural audit (required columns, monotonicity) and does not recompute the J-integral from this file.

title: J-Integral Calculation and Reporting
description: Computed J-integral values for the three target conditions, compared against hidden paper-reported values under a meet-or-beat threshold.
output_schema: columns: condition (string, one of pure_PMMA, CNT5wt%, CNT10wt%_2pct_crosslink), J_integral (float, J/m^2)
